analysis_plan.rationale: Two independent windows of pass/fail audit counts -- two-proportion z is the engine's proportions-comparison route.

changes.text: Pre-sorted carts: returns are sorted into final shelf order in the sorting room against the posted standard, exception flags clipped at sort time; pages place at the shelf, they no longer sort there.

comparison_design.description: The frozen written-definition baseline (baseline-audit.csv, 21 days, p-bar 0.065265, stable) vs the measured after window.

demand.note: Same driver as season: higher return volume through the after window.

measurement.note: Same written definition and audit procedure as the baseline; T-12 round 2 still stands.

other.note: No other process change landed in the window.

season.note: Fall reading-program returns push shelving volume up through October -- can only push the rate up, never manufacture a win.

artifact.falsification_line: Two settled weeks above 4.0% audited rate -> revert to unsorted carts and take the next-ranked cause.

inclusion.who_or_what: All re-shelved returns across adult/juvenile/nonfiction, both shifts, the daily shelf-read audit's rotating ranges

artifact.notes: One change only -- bundling the December training refresher into this pilot would be EXIT-10 territory; the refresher stays in the implementation plan instead.
